description: Ask an entry for a quote for the user: a price for a job they describe. Only for entries whose actions (get_entry_sections) list request_quote. Ask the user for their name and email address, and add a budget only if they give one. Nothing is sent by this call: the user sends it on Daawid's page, with a code Daawid emails them. Give the user the link from the answer.

actionId.description: Which of its actions of this kind (get_entry_sections), when it has several.

answers.description: Answers to the action's own questions (get_entry_sections), by their keys.

budget.description: The most they want to spend, if they say. Ask for the currency; don't assume one.

description.description: The job, in the user's words and language: what it is, how big, what else changes the price. Show it to them; don't add what they didn't say.

desiredTiming.description: When they would like it done, in their words: "February or March".

entry.description: Which entry: its ID or slug, from search or get_entry.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own key for this request: the same key and details within 24 hours give the same request.

offeringId.description: Which of the entry's offerings (get_entry_sections) it is about, if one.

postalCode.description: The postal code where the work is, when the user gives it or the action asks for one.

email.description: The user's email address, for the code and the answer. Ask them; don't guess.

name.description: The user's name. Ask them; don't guess.

phone.description: Their phone number with its country code, "+1 212 555 0123", if they give it.

preferredChannel.description: How they'd like to be answered, if they say.

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote
